scripts.check:cloudflare-readiness: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p=require('./package.json');const required=['wrangler.toml','src/index.js','public/index.html','public/app.js'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(missing.length){console.error('Missing required files: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1)}if(!p.scripts?.build){console.error('Missing build script');process.exit(1)}const w=fs.readFileSync('wrangler.toml','utf8');if(!w.includes('main = \"src/index.js\"')||!w.includes('binding = \"DB\"')||!w.includes('database_name = \"god-emperornovel-db\"')){console.error('Wrangler Worker or D1 configuration did not match expected production settings');process.exit(1)}console.log('Cloudflare source and Worker/D1 configuration checks passed.');"
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy --dry-run
